questions.questionText: In a company of 500 employees, the distribution by department is: IT 30%, Sales 25%, HR 15%, Marketing 20%, and Finance 10%. How many more employees are in IT compared to HR?
A pie chart shows the monthly expenditure of a household. If the angle representing Food is 108° and total monthly expenditure is Rs. 36,000, find the amount spent on Food.
The sales of a company over 5 years (in Lakhs Rs.) are: 2020: 45, 2021: 54, 2022: 60, 2023: 75, 2024: 90. What is the percentage growth in sales from 2020 to 2024?
A table shows student scores: Section A (mean 65, n=40), Section B (mean 75, n=60). What is the combined average score of both sections together?
In a line graph showing quarterly profits (Q1: 12L, Q2: 18L, Q3: 15L, Q4: 25L), what is the ratio of average profit of first two quarters to the last two quarters?
A pie chart shows energy consumption: Coal 40%, Petroleum 25%, Natural Gas 20%, Nuclear 10%, Hydro 5%. What central angle corresponds to Natural Gas?
In a survey of 1200 respondents, 45% preferred Product A, 35% preferred Product B, and the rest preferred Product C. How many respondents preferred Product C?
questions.explanation: Percentage for Product C = 100% - (45% + 35%) = 20%. Respondents = 20% of 1200 = 240.

questions.questionText: Production of cars by 3 plants P, Q, R in a year are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. If Plant Q produced 16,000 cars, find the total car production across all three plants.
questions.explanation: 4 parts = 16000 => 1 part = 4000. Total parts = 3 + 4 + 5 = 12 parts. Total production = 12 * 4000 = 48,000 cars.

questions.questionText: Export data of wheat (in tonnes) for 4 quarters: Q1: 400, Q2: 480, Q3: 520, Q4: 600. What is the quarterly average export of wheat?
In a double bar chart, Company X produced 50,000 units and sold 42,000 units. Company Y produced 60,000 units and sold 48,000 units. Which company had a higher sales-to-production percentage?
questions.explanation: Company X: (42000 / 50000) * 100% = 84%. Company Y: (48000 / 60000) * 100% = 80%. Company X is higher with 84%.

questions.questionText: A pie chart shows expenditure on a book publication: Paper Cost 25%, Printing 20%, Binding 20%, Royalty 15%, Promotion 10%, Transport 10%. If Royalty paid is Rs. 30,000, what is the Printing cost?
questions.explanation: Royalty is 15% = Rs. 30,000 => 1% = Rs. 2,000. Printing cost is 20% = 20 * 2000 = Rs. 40,000.

questions.questionText: In a radar chart showing skill ratings (out of 10) for a candidate: Coding: 9, Logic: 8, Communication: 7, Domain: 8, Aptitude: 8. What is the overall percentage score?
A table records annual revenue and expenditure of a firm: Revenue = Rs. 85 Lakhs, Expenditure = Rs. 68 Lakhs. What is the profit margin percentage (Profit / Revenue)?
The pass percentage in three colleges A, B, C are 80%, 75%, and 90% with student strengths 200, 400, and 300 respectively. What is the overall pass percentage across all 3 colleges?
A line graph tracking stock index over 4 weeks: W1: 15000, W2: 15300, W3: 15150, W4: 15604.5. What was the net percentage change from W1 to W4?
In a college library, books by subject are: Science 35%, Arts 25%, Commerce 20%, Literature 15%, Others 5%. If total books are 8,000, how many books are in Science and Arts combined?
A stacked bar chart shows expenditure breakdown for Year 1 (Total: 40L, R&D: 8L) and Year 2 (Total: 60L, R&D: 15L). What is the percentage increase in R&D expenditure?
A histogram shows distribution of employee salaries: 10k-20k (15), 20k-30k (25), 30k-40k (35), 40k-50k (20), 50k-60k (5). What percentage of employees earn at least 30k?
questions.explanation: Total employees = 15 + 25 + 35 + 20 + 5 = 100. Employees earning at least 30k = 35 + 20 + 5 = 60. Percentage = 60%.

questions.questionText: A table records production defective rates: Batch 1 (500 units, 2% defective), Batch 2 (300 units, 4% defective), Batch 3 (200 units, 5% defective). What is the overall defect rate?
questions.explanation: Defectives: Batch 1 = 10, Batch 2 = 12, Batch 3 = 10. Total defectives = 32. Total units = 1000. Defect rate = (32 / 1000) * 100% = 3.2%.

questions.questionText: If the central angle in a pie chart representing "Savings" is 54°, what percentage of income is saved?

In a bar graph showing rainfall (in mm) for 5 months: June: 120, July: 180, August: 200, Sept: 140, Oct: 60. Which month recorded the highest rainfall and what was its percentage contribution to total monsoon rain?
questions.explanation: Total rainfall = 120 + 180 + 200 + 140 + 60 = 700 mm. Highest is August with 200 mm. Percentage = (200 / 700) * 100% = 28.57%.

questions.questionText: A table shows employee distribution: Males = 60% of total 450 employees. If 40% of males and 30% of females are postgraduates, how many postgraduates are there in total?
questions.explanation: Males = 0.60 * 450 = 270. Females = 180. Postgraduate males = 0.40 * 270 = 108. Postgraduate females = 0.30 * 180 = 54. Total postgraduates = 108 + 54 = 162.

questions.questionText: A line graph tracking monthly website visits: Jan: 50k, Feb: 65k, Mar: 52k, Apr: 78k. What is the percentage increase in visits from Mar to Apr?
A pie chart shows vehicle market share: Sedans 35%, SUVs 40%, Hatchbacks 15%, Trucks 10%. If total vehicles sold is 1,20,000, find the difference in sales between SUVs and Hatchbacks.

In a double bar chart showing import and export for 3 years: Year 1 (Exp: 40, Imp: 50), Year 2 (Exp: 60, Imp: 45), Year 3 (Exp: 75, Imp: 60). In which years was there a trade surplus (Exports > Imports)?
A table records marks in 5 subjects out of 100: Math: 92, Physics: 88, Chemistry: 85, English: 75, CS: 95. What is the aggregate percentage score?
In a pie chart, angles for raw materials are: Steel 120°, Cement 90°, Timber 60°, Labour 50°, Others 40°. If Steel cost is Rs. 2,40,000, find total project cost.
A table lists store performance: Store A (Sales: Rs. 15L, Profit: 15%), Store B (Sales: Rs. 20L, Profit: 10%), Store C (Sales: Rs. 25L, Profit: 12%). Which store generated highest absolute profit?
questions.explanation: Store A profit = 0.15 * 15 = Rs. 2.25L. Store B profit = 0.10 * 20 = Rs. 2.0L. Store C profit = 0.12 * 25 = Rs. 3.0L. Store C generated highest profit.

questions.questionText: A line graph tracking inflation rate over 4 quarters: Q1: 4.2%, Q2: 4.8%, Q3: 5.4%, Q4: 5.0%. What is the average quarterly inflation rate?
A stacked bar chart shows energy mix for a country: Renewable (30 GW), Thermal (60 GW), Hydro (20 GW), Nuclear (10 GW). What fraction of total capacity is Renewable?
A survey table: 500 households surveyed. Cable TV = 320, Internet = 280, Both = 150. How many households have neither Cable TV nor Internet?
In a pie chart, angles representing expenditures on Food, Rent, Education, and Savings are 144°, 90°, 72°, and 54° respectively. If Savings is Rs. 15,000, what is the expenditure on Food?
A bar graph records book sales: Monday: 40, Tuesday: 55, Wednesday: 65, Thursday: 50, Friday: 70, Saturday: 90. What is the average daily sales from Monday to Saturday?
A table records production costs per unit: Material Rs. 45, Labour Rs. 25, Overhead Rs. 10. If selling price is Rs. 100, what is the profit percentage on cost?
A histogram shows test scores of 80 candidates: 0-20 (8), 20-40 (16), 40-60 (28), 60-80 (20), 80-100 (8). What percentage of candidates scored above 60?

In a double line graph comparing Revenue and Expenses of a startup over 3 years: Year 1 (Rev: 20L, Exp: 30L), Year 2 (Rev: 45L, Exp: 40L), Year 3 (Rev: 80L, Exp: 55L). What is the cumulative net profit over all 3 years?
questions.explanation: Net year 1 = -10L. Year 2 = +5L. Year 3 = +25L. Cumulative = -10 + 5 + 25 = +20 Lakhs.

questions.questionText: A pie chart shows distribution of 720 students by hobby: Sports 180°, Music 90°, Reading 60°, Drama 30°. How many students chose Reading?
A table records flight delays: On-time (80%), Weather delay (10%), Mechanical (6%), Traffic (4%). Out of 2,500 flights, how many experienced non-weather delays?
questions.explanation: Non-weather delays = Mechanical (6%) + Traffic (4%) = 10%. Flights = 10% of 2500 = 250.

questions.questionText: A bar graph shows branch performance: Branch A (Target: 100, Achieved: 110), Branch B (Target: 120, Achieved: 108), Branch C (Target: 80, Achieved: 92). Which branch had highest percentage target achievement?
A table lists fuel consumption: City driving (12 km/L), Highway (18 km/L). If a driver travels 60 km in city and 180 km on highway, what is the overall average fuel efficiency?
questions.explanation: Fuel in city = 60 / 12 = 5 L. Fuel on highway = 180 / 18 = 10 L. Total distance = 240 km. Total fuel = 15 L. Efficiency = 240 / 15 = 16 km/L.

questions.questionText: In a pie chart, expenditure on sports is 45°, culture 90°, education 135°, and library 90°. What fraction of the total budget is allocated to Education?
A table records crop yield (in quintals/hectare): Farm A (yield 40, area 15 ha), Farm B (yield 50, area 25 ha). What is the weighted average crop yield per hectare for both farms combined?
questions.explanation: Total yield = 40 * 15 + 50 * 25 = 600 + 1250 = 1850 quintals. Total area = 40 ha. Average = 1850 / 40 = 46.25 quintals/ha.

questions.questionText: A line graph tracking annual patent filings: 2021: 120, 2022: 150, 2023: 180, 2024: 216. What is the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) multiplier per year?
A bar chart shows quarterly sales (in thousands): Q1: 25, Q2: 35, Q3: 40, Q4: 60. What percent of the total annual sales occurred in the 4th quarter?

In a double bar chart showing male and female literacy rates across 3 districts: District 1 (M: 80%, F: 60%), District 2 (M: 90%, F: 70%), District 3 (M: 85%, F: 75%). Which district has the minimum gender gap in literacy?
questions.explanation: Gaps: District 1 = 20%, District 2 = 20%, District 3 = 10%. District 3 has the minimum gap (10%).

questions.questionText: A table records customer service ratings: Excellent (40%), Good (35%), Average (15%), Poor (10%). If 800 respondents took part, how many rated the service above Average (Excellent or Good)?
In a pie chart, angles for marketing channels are: Social Media 126°, Search Ads 108°, Email 72°, Referrals 54°. If total marketing budget is Rs. 1,00,000, what is spent on Search Ads?
A table shows employee attrition: Year 1: 12%, Year 2: 15%, Year 3: 10%. If initial staff was 1,000 and 200 new recruits joined at the start of each year, what is the staff count at end of Year 1?
A line graph shows monthly active users (MAU) in thousands: M1: 100, M2: 120, M3: 150, M4: 200. What is the percentage increase in MAU from M1 to M4?
A stacked bar chart indicates revenue sources: Subscriptions (60%), Advertisements (25%), Merchandising (15%). If total revenue is Rs. 20 Crores, find Ad revenue in Crores.
A table records hospital bed occupancy: Ward A (50 beds, 90% occupied), Ward B (80 beds, 75% occupied), Ward C (70 beds, 80% occupied). What is the overall bed occupancy rate?
questions.explanation: Occupied beds: A = 45, B = 60, C = 56. Total occupied = 161. Total beds = 200. Rate = (161 / 200) * 100% = 80.5%.

questions.questionText: In a pie chart, if the central angle for Rent is 72° and Food is 108°, what is the ratio of expenditure on Rent to Food?

A bar graph records battery life in hours for 4 phone models: Model A (18 hrs), Model B (24 hrs), Model C (20 hrs), Model D (30 hrs). What is the percentage difference between Model D and Model A relative to Model A?
A table tracks vehicle fuel efficiency: Car 1 (15 km/L), Car 2 (20 km/L). If both cars cover 300 km each, how many total litres of fuel are consumed by both combined?
questions.explanation: Fuel Car 1 = 300 / 15 = 20 L. Fuel Car 2 = 300 / 20 = 15 L. Total fuel = 20 + 15 = 35 litres.

questions.questionText: A histogram showing commute times (in minutes) for 200 workers: 0-15 (40), 15-30 (80), 30-45 (50), 45-60 (30). What percentage of workers commute for 30 minutes or less?
questions.explanation: Workers commuting 30 mins or less = 40 + 80 = 120. Percentage = (120 / 200) * 100% = 60%.

questions.questionText: A double line graph showing quarterly sales of Laptop vs Tablet: Q1 (Lap: 10k, Tab: 15k), Q2 (Lap: 14k, Tab: 16k), Q3 (Lap: 20k, Tab: 18k). In which quarter did Laptop sales first surpass Tablet sales?
A pie chart shows expenditure on a wedding: Catering 40%, Venue 25%, Decor 15%, Photography 10%, Gifts 10%. If Decor cost Rs. 1,50,000, find the Catering cost.
A table records defect frequencies per 1000 items: Solder defects (15), Component missing (8), Misalignment (7). What is the total non-defective count per 1000 items?
A bar graph records solar power generated (in MWh) over 4 days: Day 1: 50, Day 2: 70, Day 3: 65, Day 4: 95. What was the average daily solar generation?
A table lists store customer counts: Store 1 (1200), Store 2 (1800), Store 3 (1500). What is Store 2's percentage contribution to total footfall?
